messages:
jess: heads up — vendor just flagged a customs reclassification for the EU H100 shipment, looks like HS code changed and brokerage is holding the pallets. they propose a split: release non-DOA units now, hold 12 units for inspection + RMA flow. need quick decision.

aaron: rough ETA on the release if we accept split? and what does vendor want for RMA staging (their depot vs our EU DC)?

vendor-rep: (from vendor) we can release 36 units today via AWB, hold 12 pending inspection. preferred RMA path: vendor depot in NL for root-cause and DOA verification, then cross-ship. we will cover freight for confirmed DOA only.

maria: thanks. need AWB and manifest so customs can clear the released pallets. also we should confirm HS code they submitted — last time mismatch caused a 14d hold.

log-bot: AWB updated: 3AWB123456789 -> carrier: Evergreen Air. Manifest excerpt:
```
Line 4 | H100 | SN: HX-90001..HX-90012 | QTY 12 | HS: 8543.70.90
Line 7 | H100 | SN: HX-90013..HX-90048 | QTY 36 | HS: 8471.50.00
```

ves: HS split looks wrong to me — why two HS codes for same sku? that will definitely trigger questions. vendor needs to provide declaration reason. we should push to standardize on 8543.70.90 if applicable.

vendor-rep: we submitted two lines because of invoice grouping (reserved units vs active sell). i can ask customs broker to refile but it will add 24–48h.

jess: prefer split release with release-only for 36 units. for the 12 held units, we want vendor to pre-stage packaging + replacement units ready in NL so we can do next-day cross-ship if DOA confirmed. also need vendor to email a provisional credit for any units declared DOA on inspection.

aaron: action items: (1) vendor to provide corrected HS justification or refile (2) vendor to confirm RMA depot SLA and provide PO/reference for prepaid return label (3) logistics to accept 36 inbound with a temporary hold flag for the manifest.

maria: i'll coordinate with customs broker. pls cc our customs@redwood-infra on the revised filing. i'll also request temporary storage ETA at our FRA partner DC.

vendor-rep: ack — will refile HS justification within 3 business hours and send draft RMA PO and return label terms.

ves: one more ask — we need serial-level reconciliation. previous shipments had 2 serial mismatches. for the 36 released units, send the exact SN list we expect to clear so ops can cross-check on arrival.

vendor-rep: copying SN list to your email now.

jess: perfect. if vendor can't refile within 6 hours we revert to full hold and request expedited air for the whole wave (costly). prefer to avoid that. maria, a quick estimate for extra warehousing cost if split goes through?

maria: soft estimate: ~€1.75/unit/day for bonded storage + handling. if we need immediate cross-ship for DOA, add €120 handling and expedited label.

aaron: noted — finance: expect a small uplift on landed cost if we do split and DOA cross-ship. jess, can you confirm whether procurement approves vendor freight covering confirmed DOA only? we might need vendor to pre-authorize at least provisional credit for 6 units to reduce cash flow impact.

jess: yes — vendor must pre-authorize provisional credit for up to 6 DOA units, final after inspection. i'll ask legal to add clause to POs going forward.

log-bot: incident note created: #INC-2026-0452 — "EU H100 customs reclass / split release & RMA coordination". linked docs: freight_proposal_1729812345.pdf

ves: thanks. once SN list and refile come in i'll update the Dedicated pool inventory projection. if anyone sees the refile take >12h ping me and i'll escalate with the vendor account exec.

vendor-rep: thanks all — will follow up in ~2 hours with refile + RMA PO draft. :thumbsup:

jess: closing loop — thanks everyone, keep comms in this thread. if vendor fails refile, we go to plan B (full hold + expedited air) and i'll get approvals.
